title: Opened a small flour mill in Wuxi in 1902 using profits from the
statement: Opened a small flour mill in Wuxi in 1902 using profits from the brothers' native bank, marking the pivot from finance into industrial manufacturing.
outcome: The single Wuxi flour mill grew into a national flour-and-textile empire; by 1938 (Rong Zongjing's death) the business was among the largest private domestic enterprises in China.

title: Expanded rapidly through debt-financed acquisition of additional
statement: Expanded rapidly through debt-financed acquisition of additional flour and textile mills through the 1900s-1920s.
outcome: By 1921 the combined flour and textile operations held roughly one-third of national flour output and 30 percent of cotton output, per Global Times.
